accounting: Every connect intent consumes its URL even when failed or uncertain; no retry, refund, spare target or later reuse
execution_order: S1 then S2 only after complete seal/readback and conditions review; any uncertainty terminates the entire run
on_completion: Terminate after at most two intents; review saved originals offline; no automatic parser activation or further URL access
pre_connection_requirements: Separate explicit user approval for these exact two GETs
Fresh per-host applicable access-condition evidence; known official URL is not automation permission
If conditions require additional robots/terms/other requests, STOP and propose them separately; no hidden requests
New single-use permit ID, finite validity, executor/code/input/root SHA pins, durable intent ledger
Review direct connection, DNS only within approved GET, proxy environment, TLS, no retry/redirect
Synthetic worker/storage/stop tests and protection audit before live communication
public_results_policy: Summaries and SHA only; raw HTML/full headers/request/metadata/private paths remain private; no Cookie replay
publication_time_policy: Do not substitute retrieval/mtime/HTTP Date for first publication or historical availability
raw_SHA_policy: Measure SHA256 of actual original response bytes only after retrieval; do not preassign or borrow another version SHA
stop_conditions: Any redirect including same host or language/canonicalization change
Access restriction, authentication, CAPTCHA or ambiguous applicable conditions
Requested URL/query/order/host does not match the sealed proposal
Body/header/global cap, deadline or interval breach
Unknown encoding/content type, incomplete body or unverified HTML
SHA/request/receipt contradiction or save/readback/ACL/path identity failure
Duplicate attempt, stale/consumed permit, clock rollback or protected-file change

storage.root_label_policy: Fresh exclusive research-only root fixed and SHA-bound after approval, before connection
